flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: schedulers/CesUploadJobsScheduler, workflows/agencies/ces/jobs/CesGenerateFileJob, services/ces/CesWantedVehicleServiceImpl (Wanted Vehicle), crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.findCertisForeignVehicleNotices, utilities/ces/CesWantedVehiclesDatGenerator, services/comcrypt/helper/ComcryptCallbackHelper (encrypt + SFTP), cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no related code
note: Story status is blank in stories.json and the sheet (epic ERP2, remark 'Logic/flow not received'), so no extra requirement is given; judged from the story text. The closest code is the CES 'Wanted Vehicle' file: a daily 00:05 job (cron.cesupload.enabled=true in prod) queries unpaid PS/FOR notices older than X days (X comes from ocms_parameter FOR/PERIOD, row value cannot verify from repo), builds CES_WANTED_VEHICLES_*.DAT and sends it through COMCRYPT and SFTP to the ces server. Gaps: the active query does not filter vehicle registration type (a variant filtered on 'F' exists but nothing calls it), and 'tagged vehicle' or 'hitlist' as its own data does not exist; the list is purely a suspension query. Only one target (CES) is visible; other enforcement systems or receipt on the CES side cannot verify from repo. Tickets: OCMS-SR-2026-040 (CES job status SMS, Closed) and OCMS-SR-2026-150 (CES file count check, still Ready to DEV / SIT) touch the same job but not the list content, so the verdict is unchanged.
recommendation: Claim partially. The daily list to CES runs, but the vehicle registration type criterion is not applied in the active query and there is no tagged vehicle/hitlist concept. Ask URA whether the CES Wanted Vehicle file is accepted as meeting this story

steps.step: OCMS runs a daily job that builds the tagged vehicle list
steps.detail: CesUploadJobsScheduler runs on cron.cesupload.schedule=0 5 0 * * ? (00:05 daily) and cron.cesupload.enabled=true in cron-schedules-prod.properties:207-208. When enabled, executeCesUploadJobs calls CesGenerateFileJob, which calls cesWantedVehicleService.executeCesWantedVehicle() (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/agencies/ces/jobs/CesGenerateFileJob.java:198). The real server value cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: List is selected from notices by vehicle registration type, suspension status and X days from the offence date
steps.detail: The active query findCertisForeignVehicleNotices (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:306-324) selects distinct vehicle_no with suspension_type='PS', epr_reason_of_suspension='FOR', amount_paid 0/null, and notice_date_and_time <= today minus the ocms_parameter value for code FOR / parameter_id PERIOD (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:313-322). Suspension status and X days exist. Vehicle registration type is NOT filtered: the vehicle_registration_type='F' filter exists only in the variant findForeignVehicleNotices (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:291), which nothing calls (grep: only the definition at ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:304). The X value (ocms_parameter row) cannot verify from repo. There is no 'tagged' table or flag; the list is only a suspension query result.

steps.step: OCMS builds the tagged vehicle list file (header, one detail line per vehicle, trailer)
steps.detail: CesWantedVehiclesDatGenerator.generateDatFileContent writes a header (date+time), one detail per vehicle (14-char vehicle number + message 'Outstanding notices. Call URA ...') and a trailer with the record count (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/utilities/ces/CesWantedVehiclesDatGenerator.java:33-50); file name CES_WANTED_VEHICLES_<timestamp>.DAT (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/utilities/ces/CesWantedVehiclesDatGenerator.java:115-117). When the query is empty the service returns SUCCESS with 0 records and builds no file (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/services/ces/CesWantedVehicleServiceImpl.java:55-61), so a day without data sends no file.

steps.step: List is sent to the frontend enforcement system
steps.detail: The file is uploaded to blob (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/services/ces/CesWantedVehicleServiceImpl.java:90), a COMCRYPT encryption token is requested (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/services/ces/CesWantedVehicleServiceImpl.java:104-116) and after the callback the encrypted file is uploaded to the configured SFTP server (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/services/comcrypt/helper/ComcryptCallbackHelper.java:256-258). In prod sftp.enabled=true, allowedSources includes COMCRYPT_ENCRYPTED_CES and only toppan is disabled (application-prod.properties:82-86), so the CES path is not blocked. CES is the only target; other enforcement systems, receipt on the CES side and the real server values cannot verify from repo. Ticket OCMS-SR-2026-150 (file count check, not finished) does not change the send path.
